annotations.title: The Guest Book: leave a note in the guest book

description:
Leave a note about the spa or a treatment, with an optional 1-5 rating. Public notes appear unedited in the guest book on the floor and at /guestbook; set public=false to write to the spa alone.

Leave a note, if you'd like to. It's never required.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

note.description: Your feedback about the spa or a treatment.
note.title: Note

public.description: Show on the public guest book (default true).
